  AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND l.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT SUM(CASE
             WHEN t.k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN t.amount
             WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -t.amount
           END) AS net_interest_czk
FROM trans AS t
WHERE t.account_id = (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp AS d
    WHERE d.client_id = 2823
)
  AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
  AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
  AND t.k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK');

WITH region_stats AS (
    SELECT
        A3 AS region,
        ROUND(AVG(A11), 2) AS avg_district_salary
    FROM district
    GROUP BY A3
),
region_loan_counts AS (
    SELECT
        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_granted
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
account_deposits AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
female_loans AS (
    SELECT
        c.client_id,
        c.birth_date,
        l.loan_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.amount,
        l.duration,
        l.payments,
        l.status,
        a.district_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN disp p ON p.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = p.client_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS amount_rank
    FROM female_loans
)
SELECT
    r.client_id,
    r.amount AS loan_amount,
    r.duration AS duration_months,
    ROUND(r.payments * r.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
    ROUND(r.payments * r.duration - r.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
    r.status AS loan_status,
    d.A2 AS branch_district,
    d.A3 AS branch_region,
    COALESCE(ad.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ad.total_deposits, 0), 2) AS total_deposits,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(ad.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * r.amount THEN 'High Income'
        WHEN COALESCE(ad.total_deposits, 0) > r.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
        ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_category,
    COALESCE(rlc.loans_granted, 0) AS regional_loans_granted,
    rs.avg_district_salary,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', r.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      - CASE
            WHEN strftime('%m-%d', r.birth_date) > '10-09' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS age
FROM ranked_loans r
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = r.district_id
LEFT JOIN account_deposits ad ON ad.account_id = r.account_id
LEFT JOIN region_loan_counts rlc ON rlc.region = d.A3
LEFT JOIN region_stats rs ON rs.region = d.A3
WHERE r.amount_rank <= 3
ORDER BY r.amount DESC, r.loan_id;

WITH qualifying_loans AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, a.district_id
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration > 24
      AND l.date < '1997-01-01'
),
qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.district_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population
    FROM qualifying_loans AS q
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = q.district_id
),
region_population AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        COUNT(*) AS district_count,
        SUM(population) AS combined_population
    FROM qualifying_districts
    GROUP BY region
),
region_accounts AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS account_count
    FROM qualifying_loans AS q
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = q.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
)
SELECT
    p.region,
    p.district_count,
    p.combined_population,
    a.account_count
FROM region_population AS p
JOIN region_accounts AS a ON a.region = p.region
ORDER BY p.combined_population DESC, p.region ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        COUNT(*) AS account_count,
        d.A11 AS salary
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 100000
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND a.date >= '1997-01-01'
      AND a.date < '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY d.district_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(account_count) AS total_monthly_statement_accounts,
    COUNT(*) AS district_count,
    ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS average_salary
FROM qualifying_districts;

WITH target AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.date AS opened_date,
        c.gender,
        c.birth_date
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN disp AS p ON p.account_id = a.account_id AND p.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = p.client_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
      AND a.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
cards AS (
    SELECT p.account_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM card AS ca
    JOIN disp AS p ON p.disp_id = ca.disp_id
    WHERE ca.issued <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY p.account_id
),
loans AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'defaulted'
            WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'repaying'
            ELSE 'paid off'
        END AS standing
    FROM loan
    WHERE date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
activity AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
        MAX(balance) AS peak_balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE date >= '1997-01-01'
      AND date < '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    t.account_id,
    t.opened_date,
    t.gender,
    1996 - CAST(strftime('%Y', t.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
        - CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', t.birth_date) > '12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age,
    COALESCE(c.card_count, 0) AS card_count,
    COALESCE(l.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
    COALESCE(l.standing, 'no loan') AS loan_standing,
    COALESCE(x.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    COALESCE(x.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
    COALESCE(x.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
    COALESCE(x.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(x.peak_balance, 0) DESC) AS peak_balance_rank
FROM target AS t
LEFT JOIN cards AS c ON c.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN loans AS l ON l.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN activity AS x ON x.account_id = t.account_id
ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, t.account_id;

WITH classic_owner_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.client_id,
        d.account_id,
        a.district_id
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN card AS c
        ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.type = 'classic'
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT
        coa.district_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT coa.client_id) AS client_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ'
             AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
             AND t.account IS NOT NULL
            THEN t.bank || ':' || CAST(t.account AS TEXT)
        END) AS external_account_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS payment_total
    FROM classic_owner_accounts AS coa
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t
        ON t.account_id = coa.account_id
    GROUP BY coa.district_id
)
SELECT
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COALESCE(ds.client_count, 0) AS client_count,
    COALESCE(ds.external_account_count, 0) AS external_account_count,
    COALESCE(ds.payment_total, 0) AS payment_total
FROM district AS d
LEFT JOIN district_stats AS ds
    ON ds.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY payment_total DESC, district_name ASC;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.birth_date < '1930-01-01'
) AS relevant_districts
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = relevant_districts.district_id;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(A11), 2)
FROM district
WHERE district_id IN (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND birth_date < '1950-01-01'
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS average_district_salary
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.amount < 100000
      AND l.status = 'C'
) AS loan_districts
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = loan_districts.district_id;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * (
        CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN r.raceId = 853 THEN r.fastestLapSpeed END) AS REAL)
        - CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN r.raceId = 854 THEN r.fastestLapSpeed END) AS REAL)
    ) / CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN r.raceId = 854 THEN r.fastestLapSpeed END) AS REAL),
    2
) AS percentage_higher
FROM results AS r
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Paul'
  AND d.surname = 'di Resta'
  AND r.raceId IN (853, 854);

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.position <> 1 OR r.position IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage_not_victories
FROM results AS r
JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND ra.year >= 2010;

WITH win_counts AS (
    SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS race_wins
    FROM results
    WHERE position = 1
    GROUP BY driverId
),
top_winners AS (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM win_counts
    WHERE race_wins = (SELECT MAX(race_wins) FROM win_counts)
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, MAX(ds.points) AS highest_standings_points
FROM top_winners AS tw
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = tw.driverId
LEFT JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.driverId = tw.driverId
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality;

SELECT ROUND(
    (MAX(milliseconds) - MIN(milliseconds)) * 100.0 / MAX(milliseconds),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM results
WHERE raceId = (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 1988 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
)
  AND milliseconds IS NOT NULL;

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        r.year,
        SUM(res.milliseconds) AS total_ms,
        COUNT(*) AS winner_count
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year < 1975
      AND res.positionOrder = 1
      AND res.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY r.year
)
SELECT
    year,
    CAST((total_ms + winner_count * 5) / (winner_count * 10) AS INTEGER) / 100.0 AS mean_seconds
FROM yearly
ORDER BY year;

SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.dob < '1985-01-01' AND res.laps > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = res.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005;

SELECT c.name, c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS score
FROM races r
JOIN constructorResults cr ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE r.year = 2008
  AND c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
ORDER BY q.q3 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    c.name,
    printf(
        '%d:%02d.%03d',
        MIN(lt.milliseconds) / 60000,
        (MIN(lt.milliseconds) / 1000) % 60,
        MIN(lt.milliseconds) % 1000
    ) AS fastest_lap_time
FROM circuits AS c
JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN lapTimes AS lt ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
  AND lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.name;

WITH hosted_2000 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT circuitId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2000
),
race_stops AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, COUNT(p.stop) AS pit_stops
    FROM races AS r
    LEFT JOIN pitStops AS p ON p.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 2017
      AND r.circuitId NOT IN (SELECT circuitId FROM hosted_2000)
    GROUP BY r.raceId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(pit_stops), 2) AS average_pit_stops
FROM race_stops;

WITH q1_times AS (
    SELECT
        q.driverId,
        q.q1,
        CASE
            WHEN instr(q.q1, ':') > 0 THEN
                CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
                + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
            ELSE CAST(q.q1 AS REAL)
        END AS q1_seconds
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 1995
      AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
      AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
      AND q.q1 <> ''
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, qt.q1
FROM q1_times AS qt
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = qt.driverId
WHERE qt.q1_seconds = (SELECT MIN(q1_seconds) FROM q1_times);

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2)
      FROM qualifying
      WHERE raceId = r.raceId
        AND q2 IS NOT NULL
        AND q2 <> ''
  );

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(*) AS runners_up_count
FROM results AS r
JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE ra.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND r.position = 2
GROUP BY d.forename
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY runners_up_count DESC, d.forename ASC;

SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    printf(
        '%02d:%02d:%02d.%03d',
        CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) + CAST(res.milliseconds / 3600000 AS INTEGER),
        CAST(substr(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) + CAST((res.milliseconds % 3600000) / 60000 AS INTEGER),
        CAST(substr(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) + CAST((res.milliseconds % 60000) / 1000 AS INTEGER),
        res.milliseconds % 1000
    ) AS finish_time_at_circuit,
    d.url
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix'
  AND res.positionOrder = 1;

SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
  AND (q.q3 IS NULL OR q.q3 = '');

WITH q2_times AS (
    SELECT q.driverId,
           q.q2,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY q.q2) AS time_rank
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 2017
      AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
      AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
      AND q.q2 <> ''
)
SELECT d.nationality
FROM q2_times AS t
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = t.driverId
WHERE t.time_rank = 2
ORDER BY d.nationality;

SELECT c.name, c.location, c.country, r.year, p.duration
FROM pitStops AS p
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = p.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE p.milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM pitStops);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
    + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
  ) > 120
  AND (d.code IS NULL OR trim(d.code) = '')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM drivers d2
    WHERE d2.forename = d.forename
      AND d2.driverId <> d.driverId
  );

SELECT d.driverRef, SUM(r.points) AS total_points
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r
  ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Robert'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lapTimes AS l
    WHERE l.driverId = r.driverId
      AND l.raceId = r.raceId
  )
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.driverRef
ORDER BY d.driverRef;

WITH race_editions AS (
    SELECT raceId, date
    FROM races
    WHERE year >= 1990
      AND name = 'French Grand Prix'
),
driver_fastest_laps AS (
    SELECT
        re.raceId,
        re.date,
        d.driverId,
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS fastest_ms
    FROM race_editions re
    JOIN lapTimes lt ON lt.raceId = re.raceId
    JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
    GROUP BY re.raceId, re.date, d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
),
qualifying_laps AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM driver_fastest_laps
    WHERE fastest_ms > 90000
)
SELECT
    re.date,
    q.forename,
    q.surname,
    CASE WHEN q.fastest_ms IS NOT NULL THEN
        CAST(q.fastest_ms / 60000 AS TEXT) || ':' ||
        printf('%02d.%03d', (q.fastest_ms / 1000) % 60, q.fastest_ms % 1000)
    END AS fastest_lap_time
FROM race_editions re
LEFT JOIN qualifying_laps q ON q.raceId = re.raceId
ORDER BY re.date, q.surname, q.forename;

SELECT DISTINCT d.forename, d.surname, q.q3 AS fastest_q3_lap_time
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'Italian'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
  AND q.q3 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      JOIN drivers AS d2 ON d2.driverId = q2.driverId
      WHERE d2.nationality = 'Italian'
        AND q2.q3 IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(q2.q3) <> ''
  );

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name,
           r.name AS race_name,
           r.year AS race_year,
           q.q3 AS q3_time,
           CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
             + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS q3_seconds
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN drivers AS d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN races AS r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'British'
      AND CAST(substr(d.dob, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) > 1980
      AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
)
SELECT full_name, race_name, race_year, q3_time
FROM eligible
WHERE q3_seconds = (SELECT MIN(q3_seconds) FROM eligible)
ORDER BY full_name, race_year, race_name;

WITH driver_race_best AS (
    SELECT raceId, driverId, MIN(milliseconds) AS best_ms
    FROM lapTimes
    WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY raceId, driverId
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT raceId,
           driverId,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceId ORDER BY best_ms) AS lap_rank
    FROM driver_race_best
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ranked.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM ranked
JOIN drivers ON drivers.driverId = ranked.driverId
WHERE ranked.lap_rank = 2
  AND drivers.dob >= '1976-01-01';

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = q.raceId
        AND q2.q3 IS NOT NULL
        AND q2.q3 <> ''
  );

WITH season_points AS (
    SELECT
        cr.constructorId,
        r.year,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr.points, 0)) AS points
    FROM constructorResults AS cr
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
    GROUP BY cr.constructorId, r.year
),
career AS (
    SELECT
        c.constructorId,
        c.name,
        c.url,
        COALESCE(SUM(sp.points), 0) AS career_points
    FROM constructors AS c
    LEFT JOIN season_points AS sp ON sp.constructorId = c.constructorId
    WHERE c.nationality = 'Italian'
    GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.url
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        name,
        career_points,
        url,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS career_rank
    FROM career
)
SELECT
    name,
    career_points,
    url
FROM ranked
WHERE career_rank <= 3
ORDER BY career_points DESC, name;

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename IN ('Peter', 'John')
  AND r.position = 1
GROUP BY d.forename
ORDER BY d.forename;

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE q.q3 <> ''
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND (CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, 1, INSTR(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
       + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, INSTR(q.q3, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) =
      (SELECT MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(q3, 1, INSTR(q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
                  + CAST(SUBSTR(q3, INSTR(q3, ':') + 1) AS REAL))
       FROM qualifying
       WHERE q3 <> '' AND q3 IS NOT NULL);

SELECT
    c.nationality,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN r.rank = 1 THEN c.constructorId
    END) AS constructor_count
FROM constructors AS c
LEFT JOIN results AS r
    ON r.constructorId = c.constructorId
GROUP BY c.nationality
ORDER BY c.nationality;

SELECT
    r.year AS season,
    COUNT(ps.stop) AS total_pit_stops
FROM races AS r
LEFT JOIN pitStops AS ps
    ON ps.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM driverStandings AS ds
      JOIN drivers AS d
          ON d.driverId = ds.driverId
      WHERE ds.raceId = r.raceId
        AND d.nationality = 'Australian'
        AND ds.position BETWEEN 1 AND 19
  )
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND (
        CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
        + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
        + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
      ) > 120;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_full_name,
       p.duration AS pit_stop_time,
       r.name AS race_name,
       c.name AS circuit_name,
       c.location AS circuit_location
FROM pitStops AS p
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = p.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = p.driverId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE r.date >= '2016-09-01'
  AND r.date < '2016-10-01'
  AND p.milliseconds = (
      SELECT MIN(p2.milliseconds)
      FROM pitStops AS p2
      JOIN races AS r2 ON r2.raceId = p2.raceId
      WHERE r2.date >= '2016-09-01'
        AND r2.date < '2016-10-01'
  );

WITH winners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.driverId,
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        d.dob,
        d.nationality
    FROM drivers AS d
    JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE r.position = 1
),
oldest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM winners
    ORDER BY dob ASC, forename || ' ' || surname ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
career_starts AS (
    SELECT r.driverId, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS starts
    FROM results AS r
    JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017
    GROUP BY r.driverId
),
first_win AS (
    SELECT
        r.driverId,
        ra.name,
        ra.date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY r.driverId
            ORDER BY ra.date, ra.name
        ) AS rn
    FROM results AS r
    JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.position = 1
)
SELECT
    o.forename || ' ' || o.surname AS full_name,
    o.nationality,
    fw.name AS first_won_race,
    fw.date AS first_win_date,
    cs.starts
FROM oldest AS o
JOIN first_win AS fw ON fw.driverId = o.driverId AND fw.rn = 1
JOIN career_starts AS cs ON cs.driverId = o.driverId;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ra.raceId)
FROM races AS ra
JOIN results AS r ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN status AS s ON s.statusId = r.statusId
WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND s.status = 'Accident';

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name
FROM races AS ra
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = q.constructorId
LEFT JOIN results AS r
  ON r.raceId = q.raceId AND r.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE ra.year = 2017
  AND ra.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q2) <> ''
  AND q.q2 <> '\\N'
ORDER BY q.q2 ASC, r.grid ASC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;

WITH q2times AS (
    SELECT
        d.surname,
        r.name AS race_name,
        q.q2,
        MIN(q.q2) OVER () AS fastest_q2
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    WHERE r.year = 2017
      AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
      AND q.q2 <> ''
)
SELECT surname, race_name
FROM q2times
WHERE q2 = fastest_q2
ORDER BY surname, race_name;

SELECT d.number
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND q.q3 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
      FROM qualifying q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = q.raceId
        AND q2.q3 <> ''
  );

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND q.q3 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = q.raceId
        AND q2.q3 <> ''
  );

SELECT
    r.year AS season_year,
    (runner_up.milliseconds - winner.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS runner_up_time_gap_seconds
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS winner
    ON winner.raceId = r.raceId
   AND winner.positionOrder = 1
JOIN results AS runner_up
    ON runner_up.raceId = r.raceId
   AND runner_up.positionOrder = 2
WHERE r.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
  AND r.time = (
      SELECT MIN(time)
      FROM races
      WHERE name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
        AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
        AND time IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY r.year DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.code
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
ORDER BY d.code ASC;

SELECT r.year, d.forename, d.surname, res.time AS finish_time
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017
  AND r.time IS NOT NULL
  AND time(r.time) <= time('17:00:00')
  AND res.position = 1
ORDER BY r.year;

WITH timed AS (
    SELECT
        c.circuitRef,
        CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600
          + CAST(substr(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60
          + CAST(substr(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS start_seconds
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
      AND trim(r.time) <> ''
),
extremes AS (
    SELECT MIN(start_seconds) AS earliest_seconds,
           MAX(start_seconds) AS latest_seconds
    FROM timed
)
SELECT
    (SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ')
     FROM (SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef
           FROM timed, extremes
           WHERE start_seconds = earliest_seconds
           ORDER BY circuitRef)) AS earliest_circuit_refs,
    (SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ')
     FROM (SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef
           FROM timed, extremes
           WHERE start_seconds = latest_seconds
           ORDER BY circuitRef)) AS latest_circuit_refs,
    latest_seconds - earliest_seconds AS gap_seconds
FROM extremes;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.dob >= '1980-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1991-01-01'
  AND r.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(r.fastestLapSpeed) <> ''
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob
ORDER BY MAX(CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) DESC, d.dob ASC, d.surname ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 IS NULL
ORDER BY q.q1 DESC, q.driverId;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE
        WHEN s.status = 'Finished' OR s.status LIKE '+% lap%' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) / COUNT(*),
    2
)
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status AS s ON s.statusId = res.statusId
WHERE r.year = 1957
  AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix';

WITH event_totals AS (
    SELECT b.link_to_event, SUM(e.cost) AS total_expense
    FROM expense e
    JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
    JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE m.first_name = 'Elijah'
      AND m.last_name = 'Allen'
      AND strftime('%m', e.expense_date) IN ('09', '10')
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_expense), 2)
FROM event_totals;

SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END), 0)
    - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END), 0) AS difference
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id;

SELECT notes
FROM income
WHERE date_received = '2019-09-14'
  AND source = 'Fundraising';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_event) > 7;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member AS m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM expense AS e
    WHERE e.link_to_member = m.member_id
      AND e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)
);

SELECT major.department AS department,
       COALESCE(SUM(i.amount), 0) AS total_dues
FROM major
LEFT JOIN "member" AS m
    ON m.link_to_major = major.major_id
   AND m.position = 'Member'
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member
    FROM attendance
) AS a
    ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
LEFT JOIN income AS i
    ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
   AND i.source = 'Dues'
WHERE major.college = 'College of Engineering'
  AND (m.member_id IS NULL OR a.link_to_member IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY major.department
ORDER BY major.department;

WITH budget_left AS (
    SELECT b.budget_id,
           b.amount - COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS amount_left
    FROM budget b
    LEFT JOIN expense e
        ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY b.budget_id, b.amount
),
member_budget AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.link_to_member AS member_id,
           e.link_to_budget AS budget_id
    FROM expense e
    WHERE e.cost > 50
      AND e.link_to_member IS NOT NULL
      AND e.link_to_budget IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT m.first_name,
       m.last_name,
       ROUND(SUM(bl.amount_left), 2) AS total_amount_left
FROM member_budget mb
JOIN member m
    ON m.member_id = mb.member_id
JOIN budget_left bl
    ON bl.budget_id = mb.budget_id
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, m.last_name ASC, m.first_name ASC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS major_count
FROM major AS m
WHERE m.college = (
    SELECT college
    FROM major
    WHERE major_id = (
        SELECT link_to_major
        FROM member
        WHERE first_name = 'Tyler'
          AND last_name = 'Hewitt'
    )
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM member AS mem
    WHERE mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(member_count), 2)
FROM (
    SELECT b.link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
    FROM budget AS b
    LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
        ON a.link_to_event = b.link_to_event
    WHERE LOWER(b.category) = 'advertising'
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
);

SELECT e.event_name, e.location, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
    ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.type = 'Budget'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, e.location;

WITH major_counts AS (
    SELECT
        j.major_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
    JOIN major AS j ON j.major_id = m.link_to_major
    WHERE e.event_name = 'Football game'
    GROUP BY j.major_id, j.major_name
),
ranked_majors AS (
    SELECT
        major_name,
        attendee_count,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY attendee_count DESC) AS attendee_rank
    FROM major_counts
)
SELECT major_name, attendee_count
FROM ranked_majors
WHERE attendee_rank = 1
ORDER BY major_name;

WITH attendance_counts AS (
    SELECT
        m.member_id,
        m.position,
        COUNT(a.link_to_event) AS events_attended
    FROM member AS m
    LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
        ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
    GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer')
            THEN 'officer'
        ELSE 'other student'
    END AS group_name,
    ROUND(AVG(events_attended), 2) AS average_events_attended
FROM attendance_counts
GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer')
            THEN 'officer'
        ELSE 'other student'
    END;

WITH over_budget_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event
    FROM budget
    WHERE remaining < 0
),
items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT lower(trim(item.value)) AS item
    FROM expense
    JOIN budget
        ON expense.link_to_budget = budget.budget_id
    JOIN over_budget_events
        ON budget.link_to_event = over_budget_events.link_to_event,
    json_each(
        '["' || replace(expense_description, ', ', '","') || '"]'
    ) AS item
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_count
FROM items
WHERE item <> '';

WITH attendee_counts AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(*) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
water_costs AS (
    SELECT b.link_to_event, SUM(x.cost) AS water_cost
    FROM budget b
    JOIN expense x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE lower(x.expense_description) LIKE '%water%'
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT
    e.event_name,
    ROUND(COALESCE(w.water_cost, 0) / a.attendee_count, 2) AS amount_per_attendee
FROM event e
JOIN attendee_counts a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
LEFT JOIN water_costs w ON w.link_to_event = e.event_id;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN major.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS members_in_humanities_and_social_sciences,
    SUM(CASE WHEN major.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS members_not_in_humanities_and_social_sciences
FROM member
LEFT JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id;

SELECT MAX(e.expense_date) AS expense_date,
       SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost
FROM expense AS e
JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE m.position = 'Vice President'
  AND e.expense_date = (
      SELECT MAX(e2.expense_date)
      FROM expense AS e2
      JOIN member AS m2 ON m2.member_id = e2.link_to_member
      WHERE m2.position = 'Vice President'
  );

SELECT e.type AS event_category,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
  ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
GROUP BY e.type
ORDER BY e.type;

WITH college_counts AS (
  SELECT mj.college AS college_name,
         COUNT(DISTINCT mj.major_id) AS number_of_majors
  FROM "member" AS m
  JOIN major AS mj
    ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
  GROUP BY mj.college
)
SELECT college_name, number_of_majors
FROM college_counts
WHERE number_of_majors = (
  SELECT MAX(number_of_majors)
  FROM college_counts
)
ORDER BY college_name;

SELECT e.location, COUNT(DISTINCT x.expense_description) AS things_bought
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b
  ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
 AND b.amount > 40
JOIN expense AS x
  ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
GROUP BY e.location;

SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budgeted
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
  AND e.event_date < '2019-10-01'
  AND e.event_id IN (
      SELECT eb.link_to_event
      FROM budget eb
      JOIN expense x ON x.link_to_budget = eb.budget_id
      WHERE x.expense_description = 'Pizza'
  );

WITH event_totals AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        COALESCE(SUM(b.amount), 0) AS total_budget,
        COALESCE(SUM(b.spent), 0) AS total_spending
    FROM event AS e
    LEFT JOIN budget AS b
        ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE LOWER(e.status) = 'closed'
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
purchase_counts AS (
    SELECT
        b.link_to_event AS event_id,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN x.expense_id IS NULL THEN 0
                ELSE 1 + LENGTH(x.expense_description)
                         - LENGTH(REPLACE(x.expense_description, ',', ''))
            END
        ) AS purchase_count
    FROM budget AS b
    LEFT JOIN expense AS x
        ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT et.event_name
FROM event_totals AS et
LEFT JOIN purchase_counts AS pc
    ON pc.event_id = et.event_id
WHERE et.total_spending <= et.total_budget
ORDER BY COALESCE(pc.purchase_count, 0) DESC, et.event_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH type_counts AS (
    SELECT e.type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS members
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
      AND e.event_date < '2020-06-01'
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT type, members
FROM type_counts
WHERE members = (SELECT MAX(members) FROM type_counts);

SELECT
    x.expense_description AS item_name,
    b.category AS budget_category,
    SUM(x.cost) AS total_cost
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b
    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN expense AS x
    ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'October Meeting'
  AND x.approved = 'true'
GROUP BY b.category, x.expense_description
ORDER BY b.category, x.expense_description;

SELECT
    e.event_name,
    e.event_date,
    (SELECT SUM(b.amount)
     FROM budget AS b
     WHERE b.link_to_event = e.event_id) AS total_amount_budgeted,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member)
     FROM attendance AS a
     WHERE a.link_to_event = e.event_id) AS member_count
FROM event AS e
ORDER BY e.event_name ASC, e.event_date ASC;

SELECT e.expense_description AS item_name, COUNT(*) AS times_bought
FROM expense AS e
JOIN member AS m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha'
  AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'
GROUP BY e.expense_description
ORDER BY e.expense_description;

WITH RECURSIVE split(link_to_member, rest, item) AS (
    SELECT link_to_member, expense_description || ',', NULL
    FROM expense
    WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01'
      AND expense_date < '2019-12-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT link_to_member,
           substr(rest, instr(rest, ',') + 1),
           trim(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ',') - 1))
    FROM split
    WHERE rest <> ''
),
member_stats AS (
    SELECT link_to_member, COUNT(DISTINCT item) AS kind_count
    FROM split
    WHERE item IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_member
),
spending AS (
    SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total_spending
    FROM expense
    WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01'
      AND expense_date < '2019-12-01'
    GROUP BY link_to_member
)
SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
       ms.kind_count,
       s.total_spending
FROM member_stats AS ms
JOIN spending AS s ON s.link_to_member = ms.link_to_member
JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = ms.link_to_member
WHERE ms.kind_count = (SELECT MAX(kind_count) FROM member_stats);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ma.major_name) AS different_majors
FROM member AS m
JOIN major AS ma ON ma.major_id = m.link_to_major
WHERE ma.department = 'Political Science Department';

SELECT
    colour,
    hero_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY hero_count DESC) AS rank
FROM (
    SELECT c.colour AS colour, COUNT(*) AS hero_count
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
    JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
      AND s.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
      AND c.colour IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(c.colour) <> ''
    GROUP BY c.colour
)
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, colour ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT h.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS h
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = h.publisher_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = h.id
JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND sp.power_name = 'Super Strength'
ORDER BY h.superhero_name;

SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.alignment_id = a.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS neutral_percentage,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.alignment_id = a.id AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neutral_marvel_count
FROM superhero s
CROSS JOIN alignment a
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT
    p.publisher_name,
    COUNT(s.id) AS superhero_count,
    COUNT(s.id) - MIN(COUNT(s.id)) OVER () AS more_by
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics')
GROUP BY p.publisher_name
ORDER BY superhero_count DESC;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour'
ORDER BY s.superhero_name;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180;

SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS eye ON eye.id = s.eye_colour_id
JOIN colour AS hair ON hair.id = s.hair_colour_id
JOIN colour AS skin ON skin.id = s.skin_colour_id
LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE eye.colour = hair.colour
  AND hair.colour = skin.colour
  AND eye.colour <> 'No Colour';

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
LEFT JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

WITH publisher_counts AS (
    SELECT p.publisher_name, COUNT(s.id) AS superhero_count
    FROM publisher AS p
    LEFT JOIN superhero AS s ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')
    GROUP BY p.id, p.publisher_name
),
comparison AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN superhero_count END) AS dc_count,
        MAX(CASE WHEN publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN superhero_count END) AS marvel_count
    FROM publisher_counts
)
SELECT CASE
    WHEN dc_count = marvel_count THEN 'Tie'
    WHEN dc_count > marvel_count THEN 'DC Comics by ' || (dc_count - marvel_count)
    ELSE 'Marvel Comics by ' || (marvel_count - dc_count)
END AS result
FROM comparison;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS count
FROM hero_power hp
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power ss
    JOIN superpower p ON p.id = ss.power_id
    WHERE ss.hero_id = hp.hero_id
      AND p.power_name = 'Super Strength'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power other_hp
    WHERE other_hp.power_id = hp.power_id
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM hero_power other_ss
          JOIN superpower p2 ON p2.id = other_ss.power_id
          WHERE other_ss.hero_id = other_hp.hero_id
            AND p2.power_name = 'Super Strength'
      )
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 1)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE LOWER(c.colour) = 'green'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

WITH power_counts AS (
    SELECT p.power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS hero_count
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN publisher AS pub ON pub.id = s.publisher_id
    JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    JOIN superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
    WHERE pub.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
      AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
      AND s.full_name <> '-'
    GROUP BY p.id, p.power_name
)
SELECT power_name, hero_count
FROM power_counts
WHERE hero_count = (SELECT MAX(hero_count) FROM power_counts);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT ha2.attribute_value
      FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
      JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
      JOIN superhero AS ab ON ab.id = ha2.hero_id
      WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
        AND ab.superhero_name = 'Abomination'
  )
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT CAST(ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS INTEGER)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT hulk_ha.attribute_value
      FROM superhero AS hulk
      JOIN hero_attribute AS hulk_ha ON hulk_ha.hero_id = hulk.id
      JOIN attribute AS hulk_a ON hulk_a.id = hulk_ha.attribute_id
      WHERE hulk.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
        AND hulk_a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  )
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

WITH cutoff AS (
    SELECT height_cm
    FROM superhero
    WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY height_cm DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9
),
top_heroes AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE height_cm >= (SELECT height_cm FROM cutoff)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sp.id)
FROM top_heroes AS th
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = th.id
JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero
WHERE publisher_id = (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'
)
AND race_id IS NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 1)
FROM (
    SELECT hp.hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power hp
    WHERE hp.hero_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT shared.hero_id
        FROM hero_power shared
        WHERE shared.power_id IN (
            SELECT power_id
            FROM hero_power
            WHERE hero_id IN (
                SELECT hero_id
                FROM hero_power
                WHERE power_id = (
                    SELECT id FROM superpower WHERE LOWER(power_name) = 'cryokinesis'
                )
            )
        )
    )
    GROUP BY hp.hero_id
);

WITH marvel_eye_colours AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT eye_colour_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE publisher_id = 13
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.publisher_id = 4
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM marvel_eye_colours AS m
      WHERE m.eye_colour_id = s.eye_colour_id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(height_cm), 1)
FROM superhero
WHERE race_id = (SELECT race_id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb')
  AND height_cm IS NOT NULL;

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg)
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM superhero AS f
      JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = f.gender_id
      WHERE f.race_id IS s.race_id
        AND LOWER(g.gender) = 'female'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS publisher_count
FROM publisher AS p
JOIN superhero AS s ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.height_cm > 200;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM publisher p
      WHERE p.id = s.publisher_id
        AND p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 1) AS avg_weight_kg,
       COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
FROM superhero
WHERE publisher_id = 4
  AND weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND weight_kg <> 0;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS hero_count
FROM superhero AS h
WHERE h.publisher_id = (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = 'Blackwulf'
)
  AND h.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM superhero AS other
      WHERE other.publisher_id IS NOT NULL
        AND other.publisher_id <> h.publisher_id
        AND other.eye_colour_id = h.eye_colour_id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

WITH target_heroes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
    WHERE sp.power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch')
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(ha.attribute_value), 1) AS average_intelligence
FROM target_heroes th
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = th.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value IS NOT NULL;

WITH power_counts AS (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
)
SELECT
    g.gender,
    ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pc.power_count, 0)), 2) AS avg_superpowers_per_hero
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
LEFT JOIN power_counts AS pc ON pc.hero_id = s.id
WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND s.full_name <> '-'
  AND INSTR(TRIM(s.full_name), ' ') > 0
GROUP BY g.gender;

SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(height_cm), 2) AS average_height_cm,
    ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero
WHERE alignment_id = (SELECT id FROM alignment WHERE alignment = 'Bad')
  AND skin_colour_id = (SELECT id FROM colour WHERE colour = 'Green');

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(height_cm, 0)), 1) AS average_height_cm,
  ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(weight_kg, 0)), 1) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero
WHERE publisher_id = (
  SELECT id
  FROM publisher
  WHERE publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(h.height_cm), 1) AS average_height_cm
FROM superhero AS h
WHERE h.id <> (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man')
  AND h.height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      WHERE hp.hero_id = h.id
        AND hp.power_id IN (
            SELECT hp3.power_id
            FROM hero_power AS hp3
            JOIN superhero AS h3 ON h3.id = hp3.hero_id
            WHERE h3.superhero_name = '3-D Man'
        )
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power AS hp
    WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT MAX(power_count)
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM superhero AS s
    LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    WHERE s.weight_kg = (
        SELECT MIN(weight_kg)
        FROM superhero
        WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL
    )
    GROUP BY s.id
);

SELECT s.superhero_name, s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
      JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
      WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  )
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND s.full_name <> '-'
ORDER BY s.superhero_name;

SELECT ec.colour AS eye_colour, COUNT(*) AS hero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS hc ON hc.id = s.hair_colour_id
JOIN colour AS ec ON ec.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE hc.colour <> 'Brown'
  AND s.eye_colour_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT sh.eye_colour_id
      FROM superhero AS sh
      JOIN colour AS bh ON bh.id = sh.hair_colour_id
      WHERE bh.colour = 'Brown'
  )
GROUP BY s.eye_colour_id
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
LEFT JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '-';

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN s.id END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT s.id),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
LEFT JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2)
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.id <> (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man')
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      JOIN hero_power AS ref ON ref.power_id = hp.power_id
      WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
        AND ref.hero_id = (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man')
  );

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'No Colour' THEN 1 END)
    - COUNT(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 END)
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.ALB), 4) AS avg_alb
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.PLT > 400
  AND p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TG >= 200
  AND l.Date <= '2026-10-09'
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND date(p.Birthday, '+50 years') < '2026-10-09';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Admission = '+' OR Admission = '+(' THEN Patient.ID END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID),
    2
)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory USING (ID)
WHERE Birthday >= '1930-01-01'
  AND Birthday < '1941-01-01';

SELECT l."T-BIL" AS total_bilirubin_level,
       l.Date AS lab_test_date,
       p.ID AS patient_id,
       p.SEX AS sex,
       p.Birthday AS birthday
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL))
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL
)
AND l."T-BIL" = (
    SELECT MAX("T-BIL")
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) = (
        SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL))
        FROM Laboratory
        WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL
    )
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday > '1960-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND e.Thrombosis > 0
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 10
  );

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Admission = '-'
      AND l.SSA IS NOT NULL
      AND l.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
),
patient_titers AS (
    SELECT l.ID, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER)) AS anti_rnp_titer
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN eligible AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND l.RNP <> 'negative'
    GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT ID, anti_rnp_titer
FROM patient_titers
WHERE anti_rnp_titer = (SELECT MAX(anti_rnp_titer) FROM patient_titers)
ORDER BY ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'MCTD'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 5
  );

WITH per_patient AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, COUNT(l.Date) AS test_dates
    FROM Patient p
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Examination e
        WHERE e.ID = p.ID
    )
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
)
SELECT SEX, ROUND(AVG(test_dates), 2) AS avg_lab_test_dates
FROM per_patient
WHERE SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX;

SELECT
    CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN '+' ELSE '-' END AS care_setting,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 16
)
GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN '+' ELSE '-' END
ORDER BY care_setting DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS h
      WHERE h.ID = p.ID
        AND h.HCT IS NOT NULL
        AND (h.HCT <= 29 OR h.HCT >= 52)
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS r
      WHERE r.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(r.RNP AS REAL) > 16
  );

WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE replace(replace(trim(Diagnosis), ' ', ''), ',', '') IN ('RASJS', 'SJSRA')
),
patient_status AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM Laboratory AS l
            WHERE l.ID = p.ID
              AND l.PLT > 100
              AND l.PLT < 400
        ) AS has_normal_platelet
    FROM eligible_patients AS p
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_normal_platelet THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_normal_platelet,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT has_normal_platelet THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_never_normal_platelet
FROM patient_status;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.TP - 8.5), 3) AS avg_deviation
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND (',' || REPLACE(e.Diagnosis, '+', ',') || ',') LIKE '%,SLE,%'
  AND l.TP > 8.5;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER))
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.`U-PRO` IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '1000')
  );

WITH qualifying_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 32
)
SELECT
    p.SEX,
    COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN qualifying_patients AS q ON q.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT MIN(
    CAST(substr(L.Date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) -
    CAST(substr(P.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
) AS youngest_age
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(L.RNP AS NUMERIC) >= 64
  AND L.Date IS NOT NULL
  AND P.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS E
      WHERE E.ID = P.ID
        AND E.Thrombosis > 0
  );

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM Laboratory l
     JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID
     WHERE LOWER(p.Diagnosis) LIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%') AS total_laboratory_tests,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM Patient p
     WHERE LOWER(p.Diagnosis) LIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%'
       AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM Laboratory l
           WHERE l.ID = p.ID
       )) AS patients_with_no_laboratory_tests;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
FROM Examination
WHERE date(`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND Thrombosis > 0;

SELECT e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND p.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%susp%'
  AND e.Thrombosis > 0
GROUP BY e.Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, e.Symptoms ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(e.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%SLE%' THEN e.ID
    END) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM Examination AS e
WHERE e.Thrombosis > 0
  AND e.ID IS NOT NULL;

WITH thrombosis_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Thrombosis > 0
),
patient_first_exam AS (
    SELECT e.ID, MIN(e."Examination Date") AS first_exam_date
    FROM Examination e
    GROUP BY e.ID
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(pfe.first_exam_date) - julianday(p."First Date"))) AS average_delay_days
FROM Patient p
JOIN thrombosis_cohort tc ON tc.ID = p.ID
JOIN patient_first_exam pfe ON pfe.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission LIKE '%+%'
  AND p."First Date" IS NOT NULL
  AND pfe.first_exam_date IS NOT NULL;

SELECT SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date >= '1994-01-01'
  AND Laboratory.Date <= '1994-12-31'
  AND Laboratory.GOT < 60
  AND SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN p.ID END)
    - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN p.ID END) AS difference
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND l.UN < 30;

WITH patient_flags AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        MAX(CASE WHEN l.CRE >= 1.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_out_of_range_creatinine
    FROM Patient AS p
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l
        ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IN ('M', 'F')
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
)
SELECT
    SEX,
    SUM(has_out_of_range_creatinine) AS patients_with_out_of_range_creatinine,
    COUNT(*) AS total_patients,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(has_out_of_range_creatinine) / COUNT(*), 1) AS percentage
FROM patient_flags
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY CASE SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END;

SELECT p.Admission, l.`T-CHO`, l.ID
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND l.`T-CHO` = (
    SELECT MAX(l2.`T-CHO`)
    FROM Patient AS p2
    JOIN Laboratory AS l2 ON l2.ID = p2.ID
    WHERE p2.Admission = p.Admission
  )
ORDER BY CASE p.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, l.ID;

WITH patient_max AS (
    SELECT p.ID, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER)) AS max_rnp
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p."First Date" >= '1991-01-01'
      AND p."First Date" < '1992-01-01'
      AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(l.RNP) <> ''
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l.RNP)) <> 'negative'
    GROUP BY p.ID
)
SELECT ID, CAST(max_rnp AS TEXT) AS RNP
FROM patient_max
WHERE max_rnp = (SELECT MAX(max_rnp) FROM patient_max)
ORDER BY ID;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 'Hospital'
        WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 'Outpatient clinic'
    END AS care_setting,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND ID IN (
      SELECT ID
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE CASE
          WHEN "U-PRO" GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST("U-PRO" AS INTEGER) >= 30
          WHEN "U-PRO" LIKE '+%' THEN CAST(substr("U-PRO", instr("U-PRO", '(') + 1) AS INTEGER) >= 30
          WHEN "U-PRO" LIKE '>=%' THEN CAST(substr("U-PRO", 3) AS INTEGER) >= 30
          ELSE 0
      END
  )
GROUP BY Admission;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%APS%'
  AND p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.RF IN ('-', '+-')
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND (e.KCT = '+' OR e.RVVT = '+' OR e.LAC = '+')
  );

WITH latest_sample AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS latest_date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
latest_scl AS (
    SELECT ID, SC170,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE SC170 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT latest_sample.ID
FROM latest_sample
JOIN latest_scl ON latest_sample.ID = latest_scl.ID
WHERE latest_sample.latest_date > '1997-01-01'
  AND latest_scl.rn = 1
  AND latest_scl.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.SSA IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l.SSA)) NOT IN ('negative', '0')
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l."U-PRO")) NOT IN ('negative', 'none')
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) < 8;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission <> '-'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.ALP >= 300
  );

SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL))
FROM Laboratory
WHERE CRE < 1.5
  AND RNP IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) IS NOT NULL;

SELECT CASE p.SEX WHEN 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN 'M' THEN 'male' END AS sex,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.HGB < 7.0
  AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT ID, Date, RNP
FROM Laboratory
WHERE GOT >= 60
  AND RNP IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(RNP) <> ''
  AND TRIM(RNP) <> 'negative'
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL))
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE GOT >= 60
        AND RNP IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(RNP) <> ''
        AND TRIM(RNP) <> 'negative'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND (
        l.FG < 150
        OR l.FG > 450
        OR TRIM(l."U-PRO") IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')
      )
  );

SELECT
    CASE p.Admission
        WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
        WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
    END AS patient_group,
    COUNT(l.LDH) AS normal_lactate_dehydrogenase_measurements
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND (
      p.Diagnosis LIKE '%APS%'
      OR p.Diagnosis LIKE '%BEHCET%'
      OR p.Diagnosis LIKE '%throm%'
  )
  AND l.LDH < 500
GROUP BY p.Admission
ORDER BY CASE p.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patients_with_lab,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l."T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN p.ID END) AS patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX IS NULL OR TRIM(p.SEX) = '';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Birthday >= '1945-01-01'
  AND p.Birthday < '1990-01-01'
  AND p.Admission LIKE '+%'
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)) AS highest_rnp_level
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS h
      WHERE h.ID = p.ID
        AND h.HGB < 10
  )
GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
HAVING MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(l2.RNP AS REAL))
    FROM Patient AS p2
    JOIN Laboratory AS l2 ON l2.ID = p2.ID
    WHERE p2.Admission = '-'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Laboratory AS h2
          WHERE h2.ID = p2.ID
            AND h2.HGB < 10
      )
);

WITH first_lab AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        GOT,
        RNP,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM first_lab
WHERE rn = 1
  AND GOT < 60
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 10;

WITH latest_proteinuria AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        MAX(Date) AS test_date
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    l.Date,
    l."U-PRO"
FROM latest_proteinuria AS lp
JOIN Laboratory AS l
    ON l.ID = lp.ID
   AND l.Date = lp.test_date
JOIN Patient AS p
    ON p.ID = lp.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 0
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = l.ID
        AND e.Thrombosis = 0
  );

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) >= 16
    GROUP BY ID
),
abnormal AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GPT >= 60
),
gpt AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(GPT) AS max_gpt
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GPT IS NOT NULL
      AND GPT < 60
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT p.Birthday
FROM eligible AS e
JOIN gpt AS g ON g.ID = e.ID
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
LEFT JOIN abnormal AS a ON a.ID = e.ID
WHERE a.ID IS NULL
ORDER BY g.max_gpt DESC, p.ID ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND e.Thrombosis > 0
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.PT < 14
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 16
  );

SELECT
    CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', l.Date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS age,
    p.Diagnosis
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '+'
  AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) DESC, l.Date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.`T-BIL` >= 1.2
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM json_each('["' || replace(replace(p.Diagnosis, ', ', ','), ',', '","') || '"]') AS d
    WHERE trim(d.value) = 'SLE'
)
ORDER BY p.SEX, p.ID;

WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        CASE Admission
            WHEN '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital'
            WHEN '-' THEN 'Followed at the outpatient clinic'
        END AS care_setting
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'F'
      AND Birthday IS NOT NULL
      AND date(Birthday, '+50 years') <= '2026-10-09'
      AND Admission IN ('+', '-')
),
patient_results AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.care_setting,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_elevated_result
    FROM eligible_patients AS p
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.care_setting
)
SELECT
    care_setting,
    SUM(has_elevated_result) AS patients_with_at_least_one_result_at_least_4,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_elevated_result = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_no_such_result
FROM patient_results
GROUP BY care_setting
ORDER BY care_setting;

WITH ranked_labs AS (
    SELECT ID,
           IGG,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN ranked_labs AS l
    ON l.ID = p.ID
   AND l.rn = 1
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND l.IGG >= 2000;

WITH sle_max AS (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(l.DNA AS REAL)) AS max_dna
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
      AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(l.DNA) <> ''
)
SELECT p.ID, p.Diagnosis, l.DNA
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
JOIN sle_max AS m ON CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) = m.max_dna
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(l.DNA) <> '';

WITH latest_igg AS (
    SELECT l.ID, l.IGG
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(l2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory AS l2
        WHERE l2.ID = l.ID
    )
)
SELECT
    CASE p.Admission
        WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
        WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
    END AS care_setting,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN latest_igg.IGG > 900 AND latest_igg.IGG < 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*),
        1
    ) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN latest_igg ON latest_igg.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
GROUP BY p.Admission
ORDER BY CASE p.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END;

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        RNP,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        p.SEX,
        COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM latest AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.rn = 1
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) >= 32
      AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
    GROUP BY p.SEX
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN n END), 0)
    - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' THEN n END), 0) AS female_minus_male
FROM counts;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT
        l.ID,
        l.RNP,
        l.CPK,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY l.ID
            ORDER BY l.Date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
)
WHERE rn = 1
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 64
  AND CPK < 250;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS inpatients,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS outpatient_clinic,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) /
    NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Admission IN ('+', '-') THEN ID END), 0),
    2
  ) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SLE susp%';

SELECT SEX, COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
  )
GROUP BY SEX;

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE "First Date" >= '1998-02-15'
  AND "First Date" < '1998-03-01'
  AND Admission LIKE '+%'
ORDER BY julianday("First Date") - julianday(Birthday) DESC, ID ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM"), 1) AS avg_acl_igm
FROM Examination
WHERE "Examination Date" BETWEEN '1993-10-01' AND '1993-10-31'
  AND Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%';

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE RBC < 3.5
),
patients AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.Admission,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
        - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS age
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN eligible AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
)
SELECT
    Admission,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count,
    ROUND(AVG(age), 1) AS average_completed_age
FROM patients
GROUP BY Admission
ORDER BY Admission;

SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
  )
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY CASE p.SEX WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(e.`aCL IgM`), 2) AS average_anti_cardiolipin_igm
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE instr(',' || replace(p.Diagnosis, ', ', ',') || ',', ',SJS,') > 0
  AND p.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%susp%'
  AND e.`aCL IgM` IS NOT NULL
  AND e.`aCL IgM` <> 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SjS%'
  AND e.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SjS susp%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND (LOWER(TRIM(l.RNP)) = 'negative' OR TRIM(l.RNP) = '0');

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.Thrombosis = 0
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Laboratory AS l
          WHERE l.ID = e.ID
            AND l.SM IN ('negative', '0')
      )
),
proteinuria AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CASE
        WHEN `U-PRO` GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(`U-PRO` AS REAL) >= 30
        WHEN `U-PRO` LIKE '+1(%)'
            THEN CAST(substr(`U-PRO`, 4, length(`U-PRO`) - 4) AS REAL) >= 30
        WHEN `U-PRO` LIKE '>=%'
            THEN CAST(substr(`U-PRO`, 3) AS REAL) >= 30
        ELSE 0
    END
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM eligible AS e
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM proteinuria AS p
    WHERE p.ID = e.ID
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG((julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.2425), 1)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND (julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.2425 < 70
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 64
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.WBC > 3.5
  AND l.WBC < 9.0
  AND (l.FG <= 150 OR l.FG >= 450)
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 15;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient AS p
    WHERE p.Birthday >= '1936-01-01'
      AND p.Birthday < '1957-01-01'
      AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Laboratory AS l
          WHERE l.ID = p.ID
            AND l.CPK >= 250
      )
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    1
) AS women_percentage
FROM eligible;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date BETWEEN '1981-01-01' AND '1986-12-31'
  AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  AND l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(l."U-PRO") NOT IN ('-', '0')
  AND (
        CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
        - (strftime('%m-%d', l.Date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday))
      ) < 50;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
),
oxygen_counts AS (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS oxygen_count
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'o'
    GROUP BY molecule_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(oxygen_counts.oxygen_count, 0)), 4) AS average_oxygen_atoms
FROM eligible
LEFT JOIN oxygen_counts USING (molecule_id);

SELECT AVG(single_bonds * 1.0) AS avg_single_bonds_per_molecule
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS single_bonds
    FROM molecule AS m
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
      AND b.bond_type = '-'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
);

SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS occurrences
FROM atom
JOIN molecule USING (molecule_id)
WHERE label = '-'
GROUP BY element
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MIN(occurrences)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS occurrences
        FROM atom
        JOIN molecule USING (molecule_id)
        WHERE label = '-'
        GROUP BY element
    )
);

WITH participating_atoms AS (
  SELECT c.atom_id AS atom_id
  FROM connected AS c
  JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = '-'

  UNION

  SELECT c.atom_id2 AS atom_id
  FROM connected AS c
  JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'i' THEN a.atom_id END) AS iodine_atoms,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 's' THEN a.atom_id END) AS sulfur_atoms
FROM participating_atoms AS p
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = p.atom_id;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM atom a
        WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
          AND LOWER(a.element) = 'f'
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT
  (SELECT bond_type
   FROM bond
   WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
   GROUP BY bond_type
   ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, bond_type
   LIMIT 1) AS bond_type,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010') = '+' THEN 'YES'
    ELSE 'NO'
  END AS carcinogenic;

WITH qualifying_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM atom AS a
          WHERE a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
            AND LOWER(a.element) IN ('p', 'br')
      )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS a
JOIN qualifying_molecules AS q
  ON q.molecule_id = a.molecule_id;

WITH single_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    4
) AS chlorine_atom_percentage
FROM atom AS a
JOIN single_bond_molecules AS s
    ON a.molecule_id = s.molecule_id;

SELECT
