  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(a.element) = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS hydrogen_fraction,
  m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS carbon_carbon_double_bond_pairs
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = '='
  AND a1.element = 'c'
  AND a2.element = 'c';

WITH plus_atoms AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
    FROM atom AS a
    JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
),
bonded_atoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id FROM connected
    UNION
    SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected
),
element_counts AS (
    SELECT
        pa.element,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ba.atom_id IS NOT NULL THEN pa.atom_id END) AS bonded_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pa.atom_id) AS all_atom_count
    FROM plus_atoms AS pa
    LEFT JOIN bonded_atoms AS ba ON ba.atom_id = pa.atom_id
    GROUP BY pa.element
),
ranked_counts AS (
    SELECT
        element,
        bonded_count,
        MAX(bonded_count) OVER () AS max_bonded_count,
        SUM(all_atom_count) OVER () AS total_atoms
    FROM element_counts
)
SELECT
    element,
    ROUND(100.0 * bonded_count / total_atoms, 2) AS percentage_of_all_plus_atoms
FROM ranked_counts
WHERE bonded_count = max_bonded_count
ORDER BY element;

SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN b.bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 END) AS multiple_bonds
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR041_10'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT b.bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND LOWER(a1.element) = 'c'
  AND LOWER(a2.element) = 'c'
GROUP BY b.bond_type
ORDER BY CASE b.bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.atom_id = s.atom_id THEN c.atom_id2 ELSE c.atom_id END)
FROM atom AS s
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = s.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id = s.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = s.atom_id
WHERE s.element = 's'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND (
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM atom AS other
      WHERE other.element = a1.element
        AND other.molecule_id <> b.molecule_id
    )
    OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM atom AS other
      WHERE other.element = a2.element
        AND other.molecule_id <> b.molecule_id
    )
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT n.molecule_id)
FROM atom AS n
WHERE n.element = 'n'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS nitrogen
    JOIN connected AS c
      ON c.atom_id = nitrogen.atom_id
      OR c.atom_id2 = nitrogen.atom_id
    JOIN bond AS b
      ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE nitrogen.molecule_id = n.molecule_id
      AND nitrogen.element = 'n'
      AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id2
    WHEN a2.element = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id
END) AS bonded_atom_count
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl';

WITH triple_bond_compounds AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '#'
)
SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS carcinogenic_percent,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS non_carcinogenic_percent
FROM triple_bond_compounds t
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = t.molecule_id;

WITH atom_counts AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS number_of_carbon_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS number_of_chlorine_atoms
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT
        b.molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS number_of_multiple_bonds,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM connected c
                JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
                JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
                WHERE c.bond_id = b.bond_id
                  AND (a1.element = 'c' OR a2.element = 'c')
            ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS number_of_carbon_touching_bonds
    FROM bond b
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id,
        m.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
        ac.number_of_atoms,
        COALESCE(bc.number_of_bonds, 0) AS number_of_bonds,
        ac.number_of_carbon_atoms,
        ac.number_of_chlorine_atoms,
        COALESCE(bc.number_of_carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS number_of_carbon_touching_bonds,
        COALESCE(bc.number_of_multiple_bonds, 0) AS number_of_multiple_bonds
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom_counts ac ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN bond_counts bc ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE ac.number_of_carbon_atoms > 0
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY number_of_carbon_touching_bonds DESC, number_of_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC
    ) AS rank,
    molecule_id,
    carcinogenicity_label,
    number_of_atoms,
    number_of_bonds,
    number_of_carbon_atoms,
    number_of_chlorine_atoms,
    number_of_carbon_touching_bonds,
    number_of_multiple_bonds
FROM ranked
ORDER BY rank;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS hydrogen_endpoint_bonds
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a1.molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE lower(element) = 'y'
)
  AND a2.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
  AND (lower(a1.element) = 'h' OR lower(a2.element) = 'h');

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN a2.element
        ELSE a.element
    END AS element,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
  AND (a.element = 'c' OR a2.element = 'c')
GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN a2.element
        ELSE a.element
    END;

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND a.element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li')
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type = '-'
  )
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT a.element AS element_symbol, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS a
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
      AND b.bond_type = '-'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
      AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
)
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element;

SELECT a.element AS element_symbol,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b
  ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
  OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;

SELECT a.element AS element_symbol,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS bonded_atom_count
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM connected AS c
      WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id
         OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
  )
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element;
